[RB-FIBER-CUT#03] Fiber cut on a transport link > Differential diagnosis: ... The alarms are identical: `LINK_LOS` plus `SITE_DOWN`. ... Versus a site power failure A power failure hits one site, never its siblings. It starts with `MAINS_FAILURE` hours before the site goes down and has no `LINK_LOS`. ... `LINK_LOS` with availability at zero is a hard failure. ... A single-site event cannot take down its siblings, and the `LINK_LOS` already explains the timing. ...
[RB-FIBER-CUT#01] Fiber cut on a transport link > Overview: A transport link (node type `transport_link`, id like `LNK-XXX-NN-A`) carries all the traffic of the sites behind it, usually three to five. When the fiber is cut, or the optic or port on the link fails, every one of those sites loses its backhaul at the same moment. The sites themselves are healthy. ... Repairs take from about two hours to most of a working day.
[RB-ALARM-REFERENCE#02] Alarm reference > Transport alarms: `LINK_LOS` (critical, on a transport link). Loss of signal: no light or no carrier on the uplink. All sites behind the link go down. Strong evidence of a cut or a planned splice. See the fiber cut and maintenance runbooks. `LINK_DEGRADED` (major or minor, on a link). ... On a fiber link a minor alarm with falling optical power can precede a cut.
[RB-FIBER-CUT#02] Fiber cut on a transport link > Signature in the data: Alarms. A `LINK_LOS` alarm, severity `critical`, on the link node at time t0 ("no light received on uplink port"). One to two minutes later a `SITE_DOWN` alarm, severity `critical`, on each downstream site ("OAM heartbeat lost"). All of them clear within a few minutes of the repair, the link alarm first. ... It marks a failing fiber or optic and is part of the same incident. ...

# Transport Link Failure Affecting S-TUN-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence on the link and downstream sites precisely fits KPI drops, with changes and maintenance ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-25 14:00 to 2026-09-25 21:13
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-25 14:00
- **Affected:** S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, S-TUN-017

## Summary

Fiber transport link failure on LNK-TUN-02-B caused signal loss, dropping availability to zero on S-TUN-008 and its sibling sites.

Availability fell to zero for S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017 for approximately seven hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-25 14:00: Critical LINK_LOS raised on fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B. [ALM-000550]
- 2026-09-25 14:01: Critical SITE_DOWN raised on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017. [ALM-000551, ALM-000552, ALM-000553]
- 2026-09-25 21:11: LINK_LOS cleared on LNK-TUN-02-B. [ALM-000550]
- 2026-09-25 21:13: SITE_DOWN cleared on S-TUN-008, ending the outage. [ALM-000551]

## Evidence

- Availability and traffic dropped on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017 for 7 hours starting at 2026-09-25 14:00. [ALR-0036]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on transport link LNK-TUN-02-B at 2026-09-25 14:00. [ALM-000550]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017 at 2026-09-25 14:01. [ALM-000551, ALM-000552, ALM-000553]
- No changes occurred on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, S-TUN-017, AGG-TUN-02, and its parents between 2026-09-25 13:00 and 22:00. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, S-TUN-017, AGG-TUN-02, and its parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-B: confirmed. LINK_LOS on LNK-TUN-02-B followed immediately by SITE_DOWN alarms on all downstream sites perfectly matches a transport failure signature. [RB-FIBER-CUT#02, ALM-000550]
2. **power_failure** at S-TUN-008: rejected. A power failure hits only one site, whereas multiple sibling sites went down simultaneously with a shared link alarm. [RB-FIBER-CUT#03, ALM-000550]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000561: TEMP_HIGH warning on S-TUN-010 is unrelated to transport link LNK-TUN-02-B and occurred at a different time.
- T4: No configuration changes were applied to the affected nodes or ancestors during the incident timeframe.
- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled for the affected sites or parent nodes during the incident.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the physical fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B for cuts, splice issues, or optical transceiver degradation.
- Verify optical power levels on LNK-TUN-02-B to prevent future unexpected degradation.
